image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) perched on a textured, mossy rock. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Short, stout limbs are visible, gripping the rock surface. The tail extends downwards, showing similar coloration.
